newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony to spend Y50 bln on LSI chip lines in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Sony to spend Y50 bln on LSI chip lines in Japan.

text.p: Sony Corp said on Thursday it would spend a total of 50 billion yen in the 1997/98 and 1998/99 business years to build new production lines for large-scale integrated circuit (LSI) chips at its plant in Kagoshima prefecture, southern Japan.
"The decision to invest in new facilities for making value-added chips was prompted by recent declines in prices of conventional 16 and 64 megabit memory chips," a Sony spokesman said.
The new chips would be used in such consumer products as digital video disc (DVD) players, the spokesman said.
